title: These standard cases are stiff and rough
text:
These standard cases are stiff and rough. These standard cases are stiff, rough, and thin. I do not care for them, although I like the subtle Pistachio Green color.

They can be machine washed in warm water and tumble dried on low. After having tried these, I would never order them again.

product_metadata.title: Sleep Mantra 100% Organic Cotton Bed Sheet Set - Crisp and Cooling Percale Weave, Soft Breathable, Eco-Friendly, 3 Piece Bedding Set, Deep Pocket with All-Around Elastic, (Twin, Blue)
features: GOTS CERTIFIED 100% ORGANIC COTTON: Our 100% Organic Cotton Bed Sheets pass through stringent quality checks to ensure that the sheets are non-toxic, chemical-free, to meet the requirements for GOTS Certification (Global Organic Textile Standard). These vintage washed organic sheets are eco-friendly and produced in a green, socially compliant facility. Made with naturally grown pure organic cotton fibers, our sheets are super cool, crisp, and pre-washed ready-to-use.

CLIMB INTO COOLING AND AIRY PERCALE SHEETS - Cool and crisp to the touch, a lightweight collection that keeps you cool in the summer, unlike heavy egyptian cotton or sateen sheets. The Blue Twin sized set includes 1 flat sheet 66" W x 100" L, 1 elasticized fitted sheet (39" W x 75" L + 14" deep pocket) and 1 standard pillowcase (21" W x 30" L). Our fitted sheet has an extra snug fit and features head/foot labels for ease of use. The contrast hem pattern adds a classy finish to the bedroom set.

REST AND RECHARGE WITH SUSTAINABLE LINENS - Our organic cotton bedsheets are super gentle on your skin. Lack of harsh chemicals ensures a wonderful night's sleep for those with sensitive skin. Thoughtfully designed for a peaceful sleeping experience, our bed sheets are great for both kids and adults.

EASY HOME CARE AND SUPER DURABLE FOR HASSLE-FREE USE - Environment-friendly sheets that are made with low-impact natural dyes. Laundry care is super easy for these machine washable sheets - tumble dry on low heat. Make sure to remove quickly after the cycle ends to avoid wrinkles.

ECO-FRIENDLY PACKAGING AND SATISFACTION GUARANTEE - Pamper your loved ones with pure organic cotton sheets that come in an elegant, recyclable packaging. Birthday, Christmas or Valentine's Day - this eco-conscious, luxury gift is unique and thoughtful. If for any reason they don't like the gift, you can return it within 30 days for a full refund.
